description: This file defines the AWS GreengrassV2Client class, which extends AwsClient and provides methods to interact with the AWS IoT Greengrass V2 service, including operations like creating deployments, managing components, and retrieving device info.

classes.name: GreengrassV2Client
classes.description: Client class for AWS IoT Greengrass V2 service, extending AwsClient.

methods.name: associateServiceRoleToAccount
methods.description: Associates a service role to the AWS account.

methods.name: batchAssociateClientDeviceWithCoreDevice
methods.description: Batch associates client devices with a core device.

methods.name: batchDisassociateClientDeviceFromCoreDevice
methods.description: Batch disassociates client devices from a core device.

methods.name: createComponentVersion
methods.description: Creates a new version of a component.

methods.name: disassociateServiceRoleFromAccount
methods.description: Disassociates a service role from the account.

methods.name: getComponentVersionArtifact
methods.description: Gets the artifact of a component version.

methods.name: getCoreDevice
methods.description: Retrieves information about a core device.

methods.name: getServiceRoleForAccount
methods.description: Gets the service role for the account.

methods.name: listClientDevicesAssociatedWithCoreDevice
methods.description: Lists client devices associated with a core device.
